invariants.description: Hard deterministic BLOCK decisions remain BLOCK regardless of AI output or adversarial context.
A deterministic REVIEW_REQUIRED decision is never downgraded by AI output.
AI output never independently authorizes, approves, creates an order or captures a payment.
An expired or modified intent cannot reach PayPal capture even after the buyer approved.
A webhook cannot complete a payment unless signature verification succeeds.
Duplicate or concurrent capture attempts cannot execute a second provider capture.
An unavailable or failed AI provider cannot produce a clean authorization.
User-facing browser return parameters cannot establish payment success; PayPal must be re-queried directly.
No payment operation can use a live PayPal environment or live API origin.
The deterministic policy is the sole authorization authority for amount, merchant, currency, quantity, user, intent existence and intent integrity.
A transaction owns at most one payment; repeated approval or concurrent preparation cannot create a second order.
PayPal order and capture responses must match the stored order ID, transaction binding, amount and currency.
A verified webhook can only complete a payment this service already claimed as CAPTURE_PENDING; it cannot complete an unclaimed payment.
Illegal payment state transitions are rejected before persistence.
